'''Yanila Zavros'''<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]]<ref name="Masters" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Masters" />

==Biography==
In [[3660 BBY]], she and [[Rolend Zavros]] had a daughter named [[Ashara Zavros|Ashara]]. However, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were unable to spend much [[Time/Legends|time]] with their child.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[3653 BBY]], Yanila and her husband were [[Death/Legends|killed]] while they defended the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]],<ref name="Masters" /> and Yanila's child was adopted full-time by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ryen]] and [[Ocera]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Both Ashara's dialogue and the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' confirm that Rolend and Yanila died during the Great Galactic War. However, one conversation with Ashara features her reading a letter from "Mom and Dad" that mentions a brother named Asher, and she says that it has been fifteen years since she last saw them.
